en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph mounted on a decorative black border, typical of early 20th-century postcards. The scene features a large crane on a barge, lifting massive stone blocks by a riverbank, with several workers and rowboats nearby. Across the water, there is a tree-covered hillside. There is a faint printed text in the bottom right corner, possibly the name of the photographer or location.
